name: Codex CLI

version_poll.filter: tag_name starts with 'rust-v' AND prerelease == false AND draft == false

release_notes: Use the release body ABOVE the '## Changelog' heading only; below it is auto-generated PR spam.
gotchas: developers.openai.com/codex/* 308-redirects to learn.chatgpt.com — follow redirects, expect URL churn
Append .md for raw markdown; the global-flags table is a client-rendered <ConfigTable> stub in .md — use `codex --help` instead
The whole config reference is one <ConfigTable options={[...]}> JS array, not a markdown table — parse the key/type/description entries
Pin ?surface=cli — wrong surface silently serves desktop-app content
/docs/changelog.md 404s; the release bodies on GitHub are the changelog source
Patch bursts: batch multiple stable releases into one ranged changelog heading
Docs pages can describe commands that do not exist in the shipped CLI (0.154.0 documents `codex app`, which is not a subcommand) — confirm against `codex --help` before adding a row
Some real commands are hidden from top-level --help (`codex execpolicy`) — the docs are the source for those
